_comment: DRISHTI GPU worker — AWS deploy descriptor (Prompt 14 Part I + G.3). The GPU worker is deployed SEPARATELY from the Catalyst pipeline (which never rebuilds GPU images), with AWS CLI/SageMaker scripts, and is referenced by IMMUTABLE image + model versions. Single mechanism (G.3): ONE SageMaker asynchronous-inference endpoint. Enabled models (G.2): TabFM (workload) + TimesFM; ST-GNN is deferred. KEYS + non-secret config only; no secret values, no static credentials. Placeholders <ACCOUNT_ID>/<REGION>/... are filled at deploy time. Region default ap-south-1 (matches the retained AWS corpus / IN DC).
name: drishti-gpu-worker
_mechanism_note: G.3 keeps exactly one AWS GPU execution mechanism: SageMaker asynchronous inference (scales to zero when idle; torn down after the demo). AWS Batch / Batch Transform / real-time endpoints are deferred.

ecr.build: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 -f services/gpu-worker/Dockerfile -t drishti-gpu-worker:<VER> --load services/gpu-worker
ecr._immutable_note: The endpoint references the image by @sha256 digest, never a mutable tag, so a redeploy cannot silently change the running code.

model_artifacts._immutable_note: Model artifacts are versioned S3 objects referenced by exact key+version; a new model is a NEW version, never an in-place overwrite.

sagemaker._role_note: IAM execution role assumed by SageMaker; NO static credentials anywhere. Grants: ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer/BatchGetImage on this repo, s3:GetObject on the model prefix, kms:Decrypt on the model CMK, s3:GetObject/PutObject on the async I/O prefix, logs:PutLogEvents. No '*' resources.

production_variant._gpu_note: GPU instance (A10G). Never SageMaker Serverless (no GPU).

autoscaling._scale_note: Async endpoints scale IN to zero when idle, so GPU cost is only incurred during a run.

adapter_env_to_set._note: Set on the Part F adapter (Lambda/ECS) so it dispatches to this one endpoint. The AppSail app never talks to SageMaker directly.

shutdown_after_testing.note: Async + scale-to-zero already idles GPU cost to ~0, but DELETE the endpoint after the demo to stop all standing charges (J cost safety). The image + model artifacts remain in ECR/S3 for a later redeploy by the same immutable digest/version.
